record.question: Chairs are made _____ wood.
record.explanation: Answer D: of. “Made of wood” is used where the material remains recognisable. Independent check: Chairs are made “of wood” when the material remains recognizable in the product. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/made-of-or-made-from. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
